D/ [--]ANT IVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE [DD AVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, probably Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed left; partly off flan.
